notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: - Fixed a bug where after a finished game the player would start a new one and a part of the tree would go off the screen.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
- Fixed bugs that could cause crashes
- Changed the cost of limited trade so that the player could have time to complete the preparation for the euroassociation in the national branch of the tree

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
The possibility of a "gentle start" was added. This mode include additional power, reserves and rating on the start. You can also get achievements.
[list]
[*] Opportunity to start the game with a bonus
[*] Inflation growth has been slowed down as a result of some events
[*] Reduced abilities of centrist Ministers
[*] Reduced drop in economic growth in some events
[*] Reduced rating drop in some events
[*] Added titles of fractions in the window
[*] Shifted the display in the languages window so that the pressure buttons do not overlap
[*] Getting a European grant will increase rating
[*] Commas in large numbers
[*] Changes in the localization
[*] In the tree window you can activate "Populism" which increases the rating
[*] Increased highlighting of descisions in the tree window
[*] The rating turns green if it increases or red if it drops
[*] The conditions of the descisions do not go beyond the right side of the screen
[*] Changed ballot paper
[*] Other changes
[/list]
